reuse.why: Extends the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend with holidays and adds isSkippedDay, but keeps isSkippedDay private so app.ts re-inlines the weekend-or-holiday check twice.

duplication.why: The 'isWeekend || holidays.includes(dayFromDate(date))' test is written three times (isSkippedDay plus two inline copies in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange).

placement.why: The move rule is correctly in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily skip decision stays spread across server handlers.

scope.why: Focused on holidays, though it also changes getUpcomingDates to skip daily weekends and bumps the daily attempt cap from 7 to 366 without being asked.

maintainability.why: Nested ternaries in getUpcomingDates are hard to read and schedule-template.ts still calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays, so the rule is inconsistent across paths.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange re-implement isSkippedDay inline; server/budget/schedule-template.ts calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without passing holidays.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline holiday checks in app.ts are plain copies of isSkippedDay's expression, not reshaped.

one_place.where: The rule lands in getDateWithSkippedWeekend/isSkippedDay, but app.ts daily branches repeat it inline and schedule-template.ts weekend moves do not receive holidays.
